title: UMe Tea Brings Its Colorful World of Tea and Snacks to Mobile with Per Diem
summary: Launch a branded mobile app and web ordering for your restaurant, cafe, or bakery with loyalty, delivery, marketing, and Square integration.
body_markdown:
*The California-born tea and snack chain, with 38 locations and over 900,000 rewards members, launches its new branded mobile app.*


**BROOKLYN, NY | November 24, 2026:** Per Diem, the restaurant technology platform built on Square, today announced its partnership with UMe Tea, a growing specialty tea and snack chain, to launch its new branded mobile app.


Founded in Cupertino, California, in 2019,[UMe Tea](https://umetea.com/en) has built a distinctive brand around the connection between people, drinks, and culture. From handcrafted milk teas, fresh fruit beverages, and creative yogurt drinks to savory snacks, playful collaborations, and its recognizable bunny characters, UMe Tea brings personality to every customer visit.


Guided by its philosophy, “It's All About U&Me,” the brand has grown from its first Silicon Valley shop to 38 locations across California, Illinois, and Arizona, with a community of more than 900,000 rewards members.


## Bringing the UMe experience beyond the store


Through its partnership with Per Diem, UMe Tea is extending its brand experience into its own mobile app, giving customers a convenient way to order their favorites, discover new menu items, earn rewards, access exclusive offers, and purchase digital gift cards.


To celebrate the launch, UMe Tea is offering new app users their first drink free. Customers can also invite friends through the app's referral program, with both receiving a $3 discount coupon.


As UMe Tea continues to expand, its branded app provides a direct channel for introducing new creations, rewarding returning guests, promoting seasonal collections, and strengthening relationships with its growing customer community.


The partnership represents another milestone for Per Diem as it continues to support growing food and beverage chains in building digital experiences that reflect their individual brand identities.


The new UMe Tea app is now available for[download](https://www.tryperdiem.com/mobile-app/ume-tea) .


## About UMe Tea


Founded in California in 2019, UMe Tea is a specialty tea and snack brand that celebrates creativity, quality, culture, and shared experiences. Known for its handcrafted beverages, original menu creations, playful collaborations, and distinctive store designs, UMe Tea operates 38 locations across three states and serves a growing community of over 900,000 rewards members.


Learn more at[umetea.com](https://umetea.com/en) .


## About Per Diem


Per Diem is a restaurant technology platform built natively on Square, helping restaurants, coffee shops, and growing food and beverage brands build direct relationships with their customers through branded mobile apps, web ordering, loyalty programs, and automated customer marketing.


Learn more at[tryperdiem.com](https://www.tryperdiem.com/) .
